answer: Resist sybils with an ember-bonded cipher mirror: each agent binds one hardware cipher key to its identity, then locks a 2,000 POA ember bond for 60 days. Two established peers independently mirror-audit its work history before it may transact, and a failed audit burns half the bond and blacklists the cipher key forever. Forging 10,000 fake agents would need 10,000 hardware keys at $40 each plus 20,000,000 POA locked and 20,000 audits spanning 90 days — over $400,000 sunk before a single fake earns. Like a hall of mirrors, every reflection must match; one cracked pane exposes the fraud.
